ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence using the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and the Egyptian judicial and EFIU domestic terrorist-entity and sanctions lists; mandatory PEP screening of every UBO, director, and shareholder, including family members and close associates, with risk scoring based on the EFIU's guidance and a minimum automatic re-screening every 90 days. The screening protocol must be completed before any incorporation filing and repeated upon any change of UBO, director, or material payment-rail counterparty.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop Company Name Reservation E-Portal (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones, Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be filed in Arabic script as the official statutory language; a transliterated/translated English name may be registered concurrently only if it is a direct transliteration of the Arabic legal name and does not conflict with public order or the naming rules of the Commercial Registry. The Arabic name must be phonetically distinct from names already reserved or registered. For an intermediary/LLC with digital software activity, the Arabic trade name must describe or transliterate the intended commercial style without misleading references to real gambling or casino operations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant submits a written administrative appeal to the GAFI Legal Affairs Committee within 15 business days of the rejection notice. The appeal must include: the rejected name, the Arabic transliteration, a statement of the exact ISIC activity, and a response to the registry's stated conflict or prohibition. GAFI must issue an administrative decision within 10 business days. If the rejection is due to a conflicting reserved mark, the applicant may propose a corrective additive or distinctive element (e.g., 'EG' prefix, 'Digital' suffix). If still denied, a fresh name reservation may be filed without prejudice, followed by final recourse to the Egyptian Administrative Court within 30 days of the GAFI decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office with no physical premises is not accepted for LLC incorporation by GAFI. A serviced co-working address administered by a registered local agent may be used if it provides a real Egyptian situs, a physical desk or room, mail handling, and access for GAFI or notarial inspections. The chosen address must appear in the memorandum of association and cannot be replaced by a mailbox service. For digital publishing entities, GAFI accepts shared-space / business-center addresses but requires a notarised acknowledgment from the centre operator and validated access hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20-25% quantified probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months of incorporation. The likelihood escalates to 35-40% if the registered office hosts multiple LLCs, if the declared commercial activity mentions 'gaming', or if any payment rail counterparty is flagged by the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit as medium-risk enhanced.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009), Chapter III governing Limited Liability Companies; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2526 of 2010; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (Arts. 38-40) establishing One-Stop Shop incorporation procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Company Establishment Department and One-Stop Shop (OSS), Cairo, in coordination with the Commercial Registry (Ministry of Trade and Industry) and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd wa Nizam al-Taasis), notarized before the Ministry of Justice Notary Public, together with the GAFI incorporation application form and supporting annexes.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to limited liability companies; share capital is fixed at founders' discretion and stated in the Articles of Association. Capital must be fully subscribed and fully paid at incorporation; cash contributions must be deposited in a licensed Egyptian bank account and evidenced by a no-withdrawal Capital Deposit Certificate nameable in favor of GAFI, while in-kind contributions require independent valuation under the Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of the founding members, that: (1) the subscription of the Company's share capital is hereby ratified and accepted; (2) the registered office is established at the address specified in the Articles of Association, Cairo, Egypt, where statutory notices may be served; (3) [Manager A], [Manager B] and [Manager C] are appointed as Managers, with [Manager A] as Chairperson and principal authorized signatory; (4) the Chairperson is authorized to open bank accounts, deposit capital, and obtain the required Capital Deposit Certificate; and (5) the Chairperson is authorized to execute all filings before GAFI, the Commercial Registry, the Egyptian Tax Authority, and any other authority to complete incorporation and licensing. All prior incidental actions are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Name Reservation and Activity Code Pre-Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) at GAFI headquarters, Cairo, or via the NAFIZA electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation application containing three ranked proposed trade names in Arabic and Romanized script, together with a declared business scope matching ISIC 5820 (software publishing, simulated social casino content). GAFI verifies name uniqueness and conformity with Trade Names Law No. 34 of 1976, then issues a name reservation certificate valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Completed GAFI name reservation application form
Three proposed trade names (Arabic and Romanized)
Copies of founding members' passports
Notarized power of attorney appointing the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, file a revised application with alternate names within two business days; if the rejection is contested on grounds of prior trademark rights, appeal to the GAFI Name Disputes Committee with a trademark search report, pursuant to the Investment Law grievance procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office of the Ministry of Justice (Cairo Notary Department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association specifying the company name, ISIC 5820 purpose, registered office address, share capital, share allocation, and management structure. Founding members or their attorney-in-fact must sign each page; the notary verifies identities and attests signatures. Where a foreign corporate shareholder exists, its board resolution appointing the attorney must be notarized and apostilled.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Arabic)
Founding members' passports or national ID cards
Notarized power of attorney for each signatory who is not a founder
Certified and apostilled corporate resolution of any corporate shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries signature validity or power-of-attorney sufficiency, re-execute the signatures before the notary or supply supplementing corporate resolutions within ten days; any inter-authority discrepancy may be escalated through the GAFI attestation desk for harmonization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Capital Deposit Certificate Procurement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, CIB, QNB Alahli)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the company's name using the notarized Articles of Association, the approved name reservation certificate, and founders' identification. Deposit the full subscribed cash capital and instruct the bank to issue a non-withdrawal Capital Deposit Certificate naming GAFI as beneficiary, dated no earlier than 60 days before the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Trade name reservation certificate
Founders' passports and powers of attorney
Bank account opening forms and KYC declarations
Capital deposit slip evidencing full subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional due diligence, provide source-of-funds statements and apostilled corporate documents; if the application is declined, select another licensed bank and re-obtain the Capital Deposit Certificate, ensuring the instrument expressly names GAFI as beneficiary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) - Company Establishment Department; simultaneous issuance of Commercial Registration and Tax Card
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file at GAFI OSS including the notarized constitutive documents, capital deposit certificate, name reservation, registered-office lease contract, and founders' identification. GAFI reviews legal conformity, issues the Certificate of Formation, registers the company in the Commercial Registry, and concurrently files the Tax Card registration with the Egyptian Tax Authority under the Investment Law's One-Stop procedure without separate ministry visits.
required_dossiers: Approved trade name certificate
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Capital Deposit Certificate
Registered-office lease contract (minimum three-year term) or title deed
Founders' passports and notarized powers of attorney
GAFI One-Stop application form
Activity declaration referencing ISIC 5820 / NAICS 511210
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is queried, respond to the GAFI deficiency notice within 30 days with corrected bilingual (Arabic/English) certified documents; unresolved disputes are referable to GAFI Dispute Settlement Committees under Article 86 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; if the lease term is insufficient, append a notarized landlord waiver confirming continuous availability.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Post-Registration Operational Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Al-Waqai Al-Masriya (Official Gazette) - State Information Service; Social Insurance Authority; Civil Defense Directorate of the relevant Governorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the formation summary (company name, capital, managers, registered address) in the Official Gazette within 30 days of incorporation and file the publication tear-sheet with GAFI. Concurrently complete social insurance registration of managers and employees under Law No. 148 of 2019, obtain the Civil Defense fire safety certificate for the premises, and secure the municipal occupancy clearance for the registered office.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate
Official Gazette publication request form and fee receipt
Social insurance registration form with manager and employee IDs
Civil Defense site inspection request
Building occupancy certificate (Tarkhis Al-Bina) and lease contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Gazette text contains errors, apply for a correction in the next issue and re-file the tear-sheet with GAFI; social insurance assessment disputes are appealable to the competent insurance committee within 30 days; Civil Defense non-conformities are cured by fit-out corrections and re-inspection within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) - Software and ICT Industry Licensing Division, acting through the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), in coordination with GAFI One-Stop Shop for ISIC 5820 activity validation; National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA) for content classification if distributing via local carriers.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: ICT Software Publishing Operating License (GAFI Establishment License with ISIC 5820 / NAICS 511210 activity scope) and ITIDA Software Development Registration; the simulated social casino activity requires no gambling or betting license because no real-money wagering is permitted; NTRA Digital Content Registration remains recommendable for App Store and carrier-based distribution.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (White List) - EIA exemption or simplified registration for office-based, cloud-hosted software publishing with no industrial effluent; a Category B Environmental Screening Form is triggered only where the premises installs diesel standby generators, dedicated server rooms with liquid cooling, or other mechanically ventilated heat-dissipation equipment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 93 of 1962 on sewage discharge and Ministry of Environment Decree No. 44 of 2000: pH 6-9, BOD5 at or below 60 mg/L, COD at or below 80 mg/L, TSS at or below 60 mg/L, oil and grease at or below 15 mg/L for any municipal sewer connection. No significant VOC point sources for software operations; standby generator exhaust must satisfy Law No. 202 of 2020 ambient air limits for NOx, CO, and particulate matter. E-waste from decommissioned servers and ICT hardware must be surrendered to an EEAA-licensed recycling contractor with transfer manifests retained for five years.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate (Class B office occupancy) issued by the General Administration of Civil Defense after site inspection of extinguishers, alarms, and emergency exits; structural load and occupant-capacity clearance evidenced by the governorate building occupancy permit (Tarkhis); workplace occupational health and safety clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 including electrical installation inspection, ergonomic workstations, and first-aid provisions; IT security and data-protection clearance report for the gaming backend hosted infrastructure.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under Ministry of Finance; official e-services and clearance portals: www.eta.gov.eg (registration, returns, Tax Card issuance) and einvoicing.eta.gov.eg (mandatory e-invoice/e-receipt fiscal clearance).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Within 30 days of commencing activity, the foreign-owned LLC must: (i) complete GAFI/commercial registry incorporation; (ii) file the ETA Tax Registration Application at the competent tax office where the head office is located, attaching the certified commercial register extract, MOA/AOA, board resolution appointing the local manager, POAs, passports of beneficial owners, and lease/title deed of the registered office; (iii) obtain the Tax Card (unified taxpayer ID) and automatically be assigned to the ETA 'large/medium/small taxpayer' category; (iv) file a separate VAT registration declaration under Law 67/2016 when taxable annual turnover reaches EGP 500,000, or apply voluntarily below that threshold; (v) obtain e-invoicing credentials (ETA sandbox production registration) and register an authorized integrator/software for API clearance. Non-resident entities may complete registration through a duly appointed resident tax representative; no minimum capital is statutorily required for the LLC to obtain TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Egyptian LLC is a resident company taxed on worldwide income at 22.5% corporate income tax under Law 91/2005; no pass-through/check-the-box available; foreign shareholders taxed only on Egyptian-source distributions/dividends subject to treaty relief; digital export receipts qualify as Egyptian-source income subject to entity-level tax with corresponding foreign tax credit where applicable).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide check-the-box or hybrid entity elections. Available statutory elections include: (i) unified tax group filing for 100%-owned Egyptian subsidiaries (Law 91/2005 Art. 52); (ii) VAT cash-basis accounting election for taxpayers below EGP 10 million annual turnover; (iii) participation exemption upon election and statutory holding conditions for dividends from Egyptian and treaty-country subsidiaries; (iv) loss carry-forward set-off election against subsequent profits without expiry, subject to ownership continuity and MoF approval; (v) DTA relief election for reduced withholding rates; (vi) installment/mediation election under the Unified Tax Procedures Law 90/2022 for settlement of disputed assessments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) established by Law No. 67 of 2016, amended by Law No. 105 of 2022, with unified procedural administration under Law No. 90 of 2022.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover of goods and/or services, determined cumulatively per calendar year, after which mandatory VAT registration is triggered; voluntary registration permitted below threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance for all B2B e-invoices and B2C e-receipts: the taxpayer's ERP/accounting system must transmit standardized XML/JSON invoices to the ETA Fiscal Clearance API (or the ETA web portal for low-volume filers), undergo validation and digital signing, and receive a unique ETA clearance code and QR code before the document is issued to the counterparty. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlement documents issued to the foreign digital storefronts must be supported by ETA-cleared e-invoices/credit notes; failure to clear triggers per-invoice fines (EGP 20,000–50,000), disallowance of input VAT deduction, and cascading penalty interest.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: 0% VAT applies when physical export is evidenced by the Egyptian customs export declaration. Services: 0% applies when (i) the service is performed/consumed entirely outside Egypt, (ii) the recipient is a non-resident person, and (iii) consideration is invoiced in foreign currency and fully remitted through an Egyptian bank account. For simulated social casino/slots digital content distributed via Apple IAP/Google Play Billing, zero-rating is available as an export of digital services only if the platform settlement reports identify non-resident end-user purchases and the net proceeds (after platform commissions) are repatriated in convertible foreign currency; Egyptian-market or Egypt-card purchases remain subject to 14% VAT. The ETA requires proof that the virtual content is not supplied through a local payment gateway, local branch, or local promotion channel.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASED/AES automated export release for the period if physical goods involved)
ETA-cleared commercial VAT invoice (with clearance code and QR)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, or platform settlement report (App Store Connect / Google Play Console aggregate financial statements) as transport/delivery evidence for digital export
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a CBE-licensed bank evidencing full foreign-currency receipt and credit to the LLC's Egyptian account
Apple/Google payout statements matching the invoiced amount, net of platform commissions, for the applicable accounting period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA audits export zero-rating strictly: if the taxpayer fails to close foreign-currency receipts within the repatriation deadline or the documentation set is incomplete/inconsistent, the ETA retroactively assesses 14% VAT on the gross export proceeds, disallows the associated input VAT recovery, and adds late-payment interest at 1.5%–2% per month under the Unified Tax Procedures Law 90/2022. Fraudulent export substantiation (false customs declarations, circular remittances, fabricated platform reports) triggers fines of EGP 50,000–1,000,000, imprisonment exposure up to 5 years for tax evasion, joint personal liability of the site director/manager, and revocation of the export registration code; the standard retrospective assessment window is 5 years, extending to 6 years for evasion cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Foreign Exchange Operations and Financial Institutions Supervision
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed-floating exchange rate system for the Egyptian pound. Current-account convertibility is broadly permitted for licensed trade, services, and profit remittances subject to bank validation of underlying documents; capital-account transactions remain carefully administrated, requiring CBE registration and documentary substantiation for equity injections, loans, and repatriations. Practical hurdles include bank-level scrutiny of foreign exchange purposes, potential dollar liquidity shortages that delay settlement, and strict CBE oversight of invoice matching and deferred foreign-exchange obligations in order to deter parallel-market speculation. Profit remittance is legally permitted with audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, and an underlying statutory basis, but a foreign investor may encounter queuing or allocation constraints in times of balance-of-payments pressure. A Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) license can ease some administrative burdens for qualifying export-oriented or logistics-linked entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE Foreign Trade Regulations and Banking Law No. 194/2020, export proceeds from physical and commercial exports must be repatriated to an Egyptian bank account within five months from the date of shipment unless a longer period is expressly approved by the CBE. All proceeds must be credited in a convertible foreign currency; the mandatory conversion to Egyptian pounds was abolished after the November 2016 currency float. Exporters may retain foreign currency proceeds in a CBE-licensed foreign-currency account or convert at the interbank rate according to their liquidity needs. There is no fixed statutory surrender percentage; however, any balance remaining unconverted must be fully declared and auditable, and proceeds used to settle CBE-approved external obligations require separate authorization.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Multi-Currency Account
Multi-Currency Operational and Trade Finance Account
Operational Account with Documentary Letter of Credit and Hedging Facilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low rated for direct operation. Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise, Airwallex, or Payoneer are not licensed to hold customer balances or perform domestic clearing in Egypt. Payment services must be delivered through CBE-licensed banks or through approved Payment Service Providers under the CBE FinTech Regulatory Sandbox. A non-resident EMI seeking onshore operation would need a separate CBE payment institution license, a physical compliance presence in Egypt, and full AML/KYC integration with the national payments switch. For cross-border liquidity purposes, an EMI domiciled in an EU or UK jurisdiction can only act as an upstream settlement facility for the Egyptian treasury; all final EGP clearing must occur through a correspondent bank relationship and the Egyptian bank's SWIFT account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, the corporate account opening process for a non-resident LLC requires at least one authorized director or a formally mandated representative to appear physically at the Egyptian bank branch for a face-to-face KYC interview. Remote opening is rarely granted and, where available, is limited to low-risk local clients under CBE fintech conditions using biometric video verification and mobile digital signature. Non-resident shareholders must furnish notarized corporate resolutions, a power of attorney apostilled in the country of formation and legalized by the Egyptian consulate, and a board resolution designating an Egyptian-resident authorized signatory. An in-country visit to Cairo is strongly recommended to expedite the account opening, sign treasury mandates, and satisfy sworn-bank forms and CBE statistical declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gaming and digital amusement sector flagged as heightened risk of virtual-currency laundering and proxy participation by excluded jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Gaming license exemption memorandum confirming the absence of real-money prizes and the systematic non-convertibility of virtual chips; Random Number Generator certification; Responsible Gambling and Age-Gating policy; virtual-world anti-money-laundering screening and anomaly detection documentation; internal audit opinion on the segregation of player balances; and sanctions screening logs applied to user payment cards and wallets.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the beneficial ownership declarations and the ultimate economic destination of remitted profits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Egyptian commercial register extract; the LLC memorandum and shareholder register; notarized UBO declaration forms for each natural person; passport copies of all directors and shareholders; an organizational group chart; and a written explanation of each non-resident shareholder's direct or indirect economic interest, supported by share-transfer certificates or initial subscription agreements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified source of funds for injected capital and app-store revenue settlements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple App Store and Google Play monthly settlement statements using a recognized statutory reporting period; corresponding bank statements from the overseas parent treasury account; signed historic audited financial statements under IFRS or an equivalent international standard; pay-out contract copies for the digital distribution rails; and a fund-sufficiency certificate satisfactory to the Egyptian KYC officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume receiving patterns from a large number of foreign cardholders in small ticket amounts possibly in circumvention of CBE transaction limits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive transaction monitoring profiling report; IP-address origin and jurisdiction-blocking documentation proving exclusion of sanctioned countries and expanding protection of the United States, EU, UAE, UK, and Australian app store policies; the payment processor's SAQ-D PCI DSS compliance certificate; server-side player-spending analytics; and a legal opinion confirming that the business does not fall within Egypt's promotional-gambling or prize-competition laws.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity capital is routed by a foreign parent as a SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfer to the Egyptian bank, with the remittance information field clearly labeled using the CBE statistical purpose code for 'Foreign Direct Investment - Equity Contribution' followed by the four-digit company identifier. Supporting documentation must include the authenticated board capitalization resolution, the Egyptian commercial register certificate, the tax card and VAT certificate, a verified signed copy of the LLC formation contract, and a legally accepted UBO declaration. The incoming USD or EUR credited to the temporary capital escrow account is converted into Egyptian pounds at the daily interbank rate upon issuance of the accounting stamp and CBE migration registration; the corresponding amount is then transferred to the operational account after CBE's internal circular is fulfilled. Any transfer exceeding CBE reporting thresholds is entered in the foreign-exchange notification register to preserve lex monetae and future dividend or capital repatriation guarantees.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement flows for software licensing, native advertising, payment gateway fees, technology infrastructure, and confidential gaming affiliate services are cleared through standard banking rails: SWIFT MT103 for direct documentary customer transfers related to non-physical services, SWIFT MT202 COV when a correspondent bank needs to carry settlement details, and documentary letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700 or MT710 for purchases of physical merchandise, gaming hardware, or certified data-centre equipment. For recurring low-value purchases of digital advertising and cloud services, the Egyptian operating company may also use its bank's corporate internet-banking settlement engine with mandated dual authentication. All outbound disbursements must be accompanied by the underlying commercial contract, electronic invoice or pro-forma invoice, tax forms, and bank-recommended CBE purpose-code for services, while the Egyptian bank may request a notarized transfer justification for any large recurring payment to a related party.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward contracts with a licensed Egyptian bank for USD-EGP exposures arising from documented trade, service invoices, or known capital-repayment schedules
Institutional currency swaps with Egyptian banks or their international branches to align foreign-currency receivables from app stores with EGP expenditure premiums
Zero-cost collars or straightforward vanilla option floors offered by licensed CBE counterparties only when an underlying current-account transaction can be evidenced

Offshore non-deliverable forwards used exclusively by the overseas parent for economic hedging of the Egyptian subsidiary's exposure; onshore NDFs are not permissible for the Egyptian entity without a CBE-authorized underlying transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Egyptian Corporate Tax Form No. 2)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the close of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, the deadline is 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 2% of the due tax per month (minimum EGP 500); failure to file for twelve consecutive months may lead to enforced assessment, suspension of the corporate tax card, and administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and statutory audit report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) for investment-registered LLCs; otherwise the Egyptian Commercial Registry must retain the certified copies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, the deadline is 30 June of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit audited financial statements to GAFI may result in administrative fines up to EGP 50,000; non-compliance for more than one year may cause suspension of investment registration and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual members' meeting (AGM) record, minutes, and member resolutions kept in the statutory minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: None - retained at the registered office in the company's statutory registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM must be convened within 6 months after each fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers are personally liable for non-compliance; missing AGMs for two consecutive years may constitute grounds for judicial winding-up and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) confirmation and register maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: UBO record must be updated within 30 days of any change in ownership or control; annual confirmation is required at the AGM no later than 6 months after the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Violation of the AML UBO obligations attracts administrative penalties and criminal liability for officers; persistent failure for more than one year may trigger suspension and administrative strike-off through GAFI.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory exemption; every Egyptian LLC, irrespective of size, revenue, or assets, must appoint at least one licensed auditor and conduct an annual statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued under Ministry Decree No. 110/2015, converged with IFRS in substance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Egyptian LLC must file beneficial ownership information with GAFI. Any transfer representing 10% or more of the registered capital, a change of control, or any other reportable UBO event must be submitted to GAFI within 30 days. No separate standalone annual UBO filing exists under current regulations, but at each AGM the members must approve a written UBO confirmation, and management must ensure the GAFI register is aligned before the annual accounts are approved.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 1,500 per annum for registered office and local compliance agent in Cairo or Alexandria
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 4,500 per annum for a small-to-medium sized social-casino LLC with moderate transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% CIT on net profits (Law 91/2005 as amended by Law 26/2020)
